sections.label: Reported scam cases increase
sections.summary: Reported cases of these top scam types rose from around 2,600 in 2014 to around 5,800 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For these top types of scams, the number of reported cases has gone up from around 2,600 cases in 2014 to around 5,800 cases in 2018.

sections.label: TCTF and E-FECT results
sections.summary: TCTF closed over 600 bank accounts and recovered more than S$1.5 million, while E-FECT arrested 26 e-commerce scammers and solved over 230 e-commerce scams.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: TCTF has closed over 600 bank accounts and recovered more than S$1.5 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Within two months of its formation, E-FECT arrested 26 e-commerce scammers and solved more than 230 e-commerce scams.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This includes training frontline counter staff to spot scam victims and displaying crime advisories prominently at the counters and automated teller machines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These efforts have resulted in heightened awareness and vigilance amongst their staff, which helped prevent at least 80 scam cases involving close to $300,000 in 2018.

sections.label: Single Cybercrime Command consolidation
sections.summary: Cybercrime investigations are consolidated under a single Cybercrime Command pooling resources, alongside officer training, specialised units and community involvement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Cybercrime investigations are consolidated under a single Cybercrime Command.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: We have consolidated all the resources within the Divisions into a single Cybercrime Command, where we can pool all the resources together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The answer is yes, there is capability and there is concerted effort on our part to tackle this problem, and these are the various measures which we have introduced – from having a single Cybercrime Command, ensuring training of our officers on the ground as well as forming specialised units and involving the community.
